questions.prompt: Explain why we see different shapes of the Moon during a month.
questions.modelAnswer: The Sun always lights up half of the Moon. As the Moon goes round the Earth, we see different amounts of its lit half. At new moon we see none of it, at full moon we see all of it, and in between we see crescents and half moons.
